_comment: AS/400 library descriptions used by the DASD browser. category groups libraries by functional subsystem; status is documented, inferred, or research-pending. Entries may be expanded or corrected as additional IBM documentation and recovered systems are studied.

#CGULIB.description: IBM System/36 Environment Character Generator Utility (CGU) library.

#DBULIB.description: Recovered # library whose name suggests a DBU/Data Base Utility component, but no period IBM source has yet been found that maps #DBULIB to an IBM System/36 Environment licensed program. Keep its exact purpose unresolved until documented.

#DFULIB.description: IBM System/36 Environment Data File Utility (DFU) library.

#DSULIB.description: IBM System/36 Environment Development Support Utility (DSU) library.

#LIBRARY.description: System/36 Environment user library. It holds the user objects that would have been placed in #LIBRARY on a native System/36 and works with QSSP and QS36F.

#SDALIB.description: IBM System/36 Environment Screen Design Aid (SDA) library.

#SEULIB.description: IBM System/36 Environment Source Entry Utility (SEU) library.

QDOC.description: QDLS/document-library backing library. Folder and document objects are represented internally as *FLR and *DOC DLOs; this is not a source library.

QDSNX.description: Distributed Systems Node Executive (DSNX) support library. IBM system documentation associates QDSNX with DSNX activity and distribution/communications logging.

QFNTCPL.description: AFP Compatibility Fonts library containing the 240-pel compatibility font set shipped with OS/400, including Courier, Gothic, Orator, Prestige, and Proprinter Emulation resources.

QGDDM.description: Graphical Data Display Manager (GDDM) library containing GDDM routines, entry-point tables, and graphic symbol sets used by AS/400 graphics applications and printing.

QGPL.description: General Purpose Library. IBM-supplied home for miscellaneous system and user objects, and the default current library when a job has no explicit current library.

QGPLTEMP.description: Installation-created IBM work library that can contain internal system objects not visible through normal object displays. IBM advises that it should not be deleted.

QHLPSYS.description: System help library containing IBM online-help information, primarily panel groups and search-index objects used by the Help key.

QIWS.description: PC Support/400 and Client Access host/server library. It provides host-side PC connectivity functions including file serving/transfer and, in later releases, virtual printing, messaging, and remote SQL support.

QIWS2D.description: Client Access/400 for OS/2 DBCS support library.

QIWS2S.description: Client Access/400 for OS/2 SBCS support library.

QIWSFD.description: Client Access/400 for DOS DBCS support library.

QIWSFS.description: Client Access/400 for DOS SBCS support library.

QIWSPD.description: Client Access/400 Extended DOS DBCS support library.

QIWSPS.description: Client Access/400 Extended DOS SBCS support library.

QIWSTL.description: PC Support/Client Access tools library; IBM installation tables map the QIWSTOOL tools component to library QIWSTL.

QMGU.description: OS/400 migration-support library used by IBM System/36 and System/38 migration facilities.

QMU400.description: OS/400 System/36 Migration Assistant library, provided as an operating-system migration option.

QPDA.description: IBM application-development tooling library used by PDM and related development functions.

QPFRDATA.description: IBM performance-data library used to store performance monitor and Performance Tools collection data.

QQALIB.description: IBM Question and Answer library created at installation time; it contains Q&A-related support/model database objects.

QRPG.description: RPG/400 licensed-program library containing compiler and support objects.

QRECOVERY.description: System recovery library used for system journaling and for temporary/status objects associated with recovery or failed processes. It is intended for system use.

QRPLOBJ.description: Replaced Object Library. It holds older versions of objects replaced by Create commands using REPLACE(*YES) when the old object must remain available; the library is cleared at IPL.

QS36F.description: System/36 Environment data-file library. IBM documentation describes QS36F as the library that contains System/36-compatible user data files.

QSDE.description: Recovered IBM-style library containing QAEB-named files. Its exact OS/400 product or component purpose has not yet been identified from period IBM documentation.

QSPL.description: System spooling library backing printer output and other spooled data.

QSRV.description: System Service Library created by IBM and used temporarily during PTF and APAR processing. It is normally empty and should not be deleted.

QSSP.description: System/36 Environment library containing the SSP-compatible procedures, utility programs, control commands, and OCL support used to run System/36 applications under OS/400.

QSYS.description: Primary OS/400 system library containing operating-system commands, programs, device descriptions, and other core system objects.

QSYS2.description: IBM system library whose shipped library text on older OS/400 is "System Library for CPI's". On these releases it is part of the core/extended system environment; it should not be interpreted only by the much later IBM i SQL-services role of QSYS2.

QSYS38.description: System/38 Environment compatibility library containing AS/400-supported System/38 commands and runtime support.

QSYSV2R2M0.description: Release-qualified IBM-style library whose name strongly suggests Version 2 Release 2 Modification 0 compatibility or previous-release support. Its exact role has not yet been verified from period IBM documentation.

QTEMP.description: Private per-job temporary library. It is created for each job and deleted, along with its objects, when that job ends.

QUSRSYS.description: IBM-supplied system library for user-related and system-maintained data such as user message queues, distribution information, and other persistent system data.

QUSRTEMP.description: Installation-created system work library used while moving and comparing objects involving QUSRSYS during install/reinstall; other functions such as SNADS and spooling also depend on it. It is persistent and is not the per-job QTEMP library.

QUSRTOOL.description: OS/400 example-tools library containing IBM-supplied source, sample commands, utilities, and many TAA-named examples for administrators and programmers.
